item.title: Digital Euro Becomes Mandatory for Government Payments
item.description: The central bank digital currency is now required for all public-sector disbursements, alongside digital identity verification for recipients.

item.title: Nigeria Expands eNaira Pilot to Rural Regions
item.description: The digital currency pilot program adds ten new states in a phased trial.

item.title: Interest Rates Held Steady This Quarter
item.description: The monetary policy committee left benchmark rates unchanged.
